definition: how someone feels and thinks right now
description: A rooftop deck at sunset above a busy city. A young woman with long dark hair, in a sage green top and leggings, stands barefoot on one leg in a yoga pose on a mint mat, arms raised high, smiling peacefully with her eyes half closed. She slowly brings her palms together above her head and opens her eyes, still calm. Behind and below her a motorway is completely jammed with cars and lorries, their red brake lights glowing, under tall tower blocks and an orange sky.
